searchText: gsf-1 is live 😄 https://dora.dencun-gsf-1.ethpandaops.io/ we have some tooling up, not everything (some things break when you throw the load of ~300 nodes against it): https://dencun-gsf-1.ethpandaops.io/ We have xatu up and running, so we're collecting baseline metrics now. Deneb will go live at epoch 220 (tomorrow). So we'll have 1 day regular gsf, 1 day deneb data before we meet for ACD. Are you fuzzing it already? its still got goerli gossip 😄 some blocks have like 450 txs in them we can start the tx-fuzz too in addition, but thought there's no reason to as long as we have organic traffic warning, long URL. But for those of you that have access to the ethpandaops grafana, here's the Xatu dashboard you can reference: https://grafana.observability.ethpandaops.io/d/MR_U64N4k/beacon-api-events?orgId=1&var-network_name=dencun-gsf-1&var-client_name=All&var-consensus_implementation=All&var-consensus_version=All&var-geo_continent_code=All&var-heatmap_interval=250&var-interval_tight=%24__auto_interval_interval_tight&var-interval=%24__auto_interval_interval&var-interval_loose=%24__auto_interval_interval_loose&var-table_prefix=&var-attestation_prefix=&from=1702996864742&to=1702998664742 Collecting data from 1 of each combination (EL and CL) Also just a timeline warning, Since the # of nodes are large and cost being high - we'd like to tear down the shadowfork shortly after ACD. So if there's something people want to try, some data to capture or anything - please reach out earlier rather than later.
